title: DeepDistill: Enhancing LLM Reasoning Capabilities via Large-Scale Difficulty-Graded Data Training
authors_zh: Xiaoyu Tian、Sitong Zhao、Haotian Wang、Shuaiting Chen、Yiping Peng、Yunjie Ji、Han Zhao、Xiangang Li
paper_type_zh: 推理数据发布与构造配方
best_for_zh: 研究开放推理数据、教师蒸馏、难度分级、混合验证器与数据审计的读者
one_line: Builds about 40M mixed-domain teacher responses for roughly 3.34M sourced queries and grades them with category-specific verification, while the official data card says the public release is only a subset.
围绕约 334 万条有来源的查询生成约 4000 万条多教师响应，并以分类型验证器给出难度信号；但官方数据卡说明公开内容仅是完整数据的子集。
why: Exposes a large trace-and-feedback object for studying difficulty-aware data selection, together with enough caveats to audit verifier dependence and release completeness.
inclusion_reason: Large difficulty-graded reasoning-data release and construction recipe with prompt provenance, multi-teacher responses, heterogeneous verification, and pass-rate metadata.

title: Problem
问题
html: Reasoning SFT needs more than a large pile of solutions. Prompts vary in domain and difficulty, teachers vary in capability, and a scalar from one judge can confound intrinsic difficulty with evaluator preference. Training indiscriminately on easy, unsolved, or noisy items also spends compute without establishing that the selected traces are learnable and correct. DeepDistill asks how to construct a large mixed-domain reasoning corpus whose records retain prompt provenance, repeated teacher attempts, category-specific feedback, and difficulty signals that can drive data selection for base-model SFT.

面向推理的 SFT 不能只依赖大量解答。不同提示的领域和难度不同，教师模型能力不同，单一评估器给出的标量分数还可能把题目难度与评估偏好混为一谈。若不加区分地训练过易、未解或含噪样本，也无法保证所选轨迹既可学又正确。DeepDistill 关注如何构建一套混合领域推理语料，使每条记录保留提示来源、多次教师尝试、分类型反馈与难度信号，并据此为基础模型 SFT 选择数据。 关于《DeepDistill: Enhancing LLM Reasoning Capabilities via Large-Scale Difficulty-Graded Data Training》：审阅时应把问题边界落在可复用的数据对象与反馈合同，而不是论文标题或榜单分数；输入来源、生成者、输出字段、筛选规则与最终判定器必须分开核对，未公开部分保持为未知。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The intended corpus contains about 3.34 million unique queries and roughly 40 million generated responses. DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B, DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B, and DeepSeek-R1 each produce four attempts per query. Every response carries the question and answer, source and teacher identifiers, category, available ground truth/tests/constraints, three teacher pass rates, its own verify_score, PPL, and model name.

Difficulty is represented by observed success rather than a free-form difficulty label. Category-specific verification turns each of four attempts into a pass indicator; their mean is a teacher-specific pass rate. For the DeepSeek-R1 attempts used in the paper's experiments, the coefficient of variation (CV) of verification scores identifies unstable questions. Selection then combines a correctness threshold with CV, yielding a data object that supports both SFT and audits of teacher capability, verifier behavior, and curriculum rules.

目标语料约含 334 万条唯一查询和 4000 万条生成响应。DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B、DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B 与 DeepSeek-R1 分别为每条查询生成四次。每条响应包含问题与答案、问题来源与教师标识、类别、可用的标准答案/测试/约束、三个教师的通过率、本条响应的 verify_score、PPL 和模型名称。

难度不是由自由文本标签表示，而是由实际成功情况表示。分类型验证器先把四次尝试分别转成通过标记，再取均值得到各教师的通过率。论文实验针对 DeepSeek-R1 响应计算验证分数的变异系数（CV），以识别表现不稳定的问题；随后把正确性阈值与 CV 联合用于筛选。因而，该数据对象既能服务 SFT，也能用于审计教师能力、验证器行为和课程选择规则。

title: Method
方法
html:
Queries are aggregated from named public corpora covering mathematics, code, science, instruction following, multi-turn dialogue, and general reasoning. Exact duplicates, empty or incomplete prompts, URLs, tables, and prompts above an undisclosed Unicode-ratio threshold are removed. For AIME2024, the authors apply exact/near matching and remove queries whose bge-m3 similarity exceeds 0.9. This leaves about 3.34 million queries. Three teachers then generate four responses apiece; the prompts and decoding settings are not reported.

Feedback depends on category. Math first uses Math-Verify and sends failures to Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct for a second binary decision. Code runs the first ten available public tests, or all tests when fewer exist; Python supports stdin/output and assertions, while C++ uses stdin/output. Science answers are scored from 0 to 5 by Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct. Instruction-following uses ifeval, including constraints generated by Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct. Multi-turn and other examples receive coherence, correctness, and helpfulness scores from Decision-Tree-Reward-Llama-3.1-8B, averaged after normalization. A response passes above 0.99 for math/code/instruction following, above 4.99 for science, or above 0.7 for multi-turn/other. Four binary outcomes are averaged into a pass rate.

Quality filters discard responses with PPL above 20, repeated 20-token strings occurring more than 20 times, missing think or answer spans, and malformed multi-turn records. Stage I first requires at least one passing response. High-CV queries keep only passing responses; low-CV math/code/science/instruction-following queries are dropped, while 50% of low-CV multi-turn/other queries are sampled. The paper reports 5 million Stage-I samples. Stage II keeps nearly 200K high-CV, passing examples and randomly chooses one response per query. Category-specific CV thresholds are not disclosed.

Qwen2.5-32B and Qwen2.5-72B are fine-tuned in Stage I for one epoch at learning rate 8e-5, with 32K packing, global batch 64, cosine decay, and 5% warmup. Stage II starts from the 32B checkpoint, removes packing, keeps a 32K limit, and trains two epochs at 8e-6. Although all three teacher families supply metadata, the reported training and analysis use only DeepSeek-R1 responses.

查询来自论文列明的公开语料，覆盖数学、代码、科学、指令遵循、多轮对话和通用推理。流程删除完全重复、为空或不完整的提示，以及包含 URL、表格或超过未公开 Unicode 比例阈值的提示。针对 AIME2024，作者采用精确/近似匹配，并删除 bge-m3 相似度超过 0.9 的查询，最终留下约 334 万条查询。随后三个教师各生成四条响应；提示模板与解码设置未披露。

反馈方式随类别而变。数学先用 Math-Verify，失败结果再交给 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 作二元复核。代码运行前十个可用公开测试，少于十个时全部运行；Python 支持标准输入输出与断言，C++ 仅用标准输入输出。科学答案由 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 给出 0 至 5 分。指令遵循使用 ifeval，其中部分约束由 Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct 生成。多轮与其他样本由 Decision-Tree-Reward-Llama-3.1-8B 分别评价连贯性、正确性和有用性，再归一化取平均。数学、代码和指令遵循的通过条件是分数高于 0.99，科学高于 4.99，多轮/其他高于 0.7；四次二元结果的均值构成通过率。

质量过滤会删除 PPL 高于 20、某个 20-token 字符串重复超过 20 次、缺少 think 或 answer 段、以及多轮结构不合法的响应。第一阶段先要求至少存在一条通过响应；高 CV 查询只保留通过响应，低 CV 的数学/代码/科学/指令样本被删除，而低 CV 的多轮/其他查询随机保留 50%。论文报告第一阶段得到 500 万条样本。第二阶段保留近 20 万条高 CV 且通过的样本，并为每条查询随机取一条响应。各类别的 CV 阈值未披露。

第一阶段以 Qwen2.5-32B 和 Qwen2.5-72B 为基础模型，学习率为 8e-5，训练一轮，采用 32K packing、全局批量 64、余弦衰减和 5% 预热。第二阶段从 32B 检查点继续，不再 packing，最大长度仍为 32K，以 8e-6 训练两轮。尽管元数据覆盖三个教师家族，论文报告的训练与分析只使用 DeepSeek-R1 响应。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The paper reports pass@1 on AIME2024, GPQA-Diamond, and LiveCodeBench. Stage-I Qwen2.5-72B reaches 79.2, 65.7, and 63.8, while the Stage-I 32B model reaches 75.8, 66.3, and 64.2. Annealing the 32B model changes these to 77.9, 66.9, and 61.7: math and science rise, but code falls. A learning-rate ablation on the 72B model reports that reducing 8e-5 to 8e-6 lowers AIME2024 from 79.2 to 72.5 and LiveCodeBench from 63.8 to 60.2. These are recipe-level results, not proof that every record or difficulty label is correct.

The official Hugging Face repository makes the schema and 60 category-by-teacher-by-pass JSONL files inspectable and labels the dataset CC-BY-NC-4.0. Its card also warns that every unique question is repeated 12 times, some ground_truth labels may be inaccurate, and only a subset of the complete dataset could be open-sourced. The paper's broad statement that all datasets and methods were released should therefore not be used as a completeness guarantee. The linked GitHub project tree contains paper PDFs and assets but no end-to-end DeepDistill implementation.

论文以 pass@1 报告 AIME2024、GPQA-Diamond 和 LiveCodeBench。第一阶段 Qwen2.5-72B 分别达到 79.2、65.7 和 63.8，32B 模型达到 75.8、66.3 和 64.2。32B 经过退火后变为 77.9、66.9 和 61.7：数学与科学上升，代码下降。72B 的学习率消融显示，把 8e-5 降到 8e-6 后，AIME2024 从 79.2 降到 72.5，LiveCodeBench 从 63.8 降到 60.2。这些结果支持论文所用配方，但不能证明每条记录或每个难度标签都正确。

官方 Hugging Face 仓库公开了字段模式和 60 个按类别、教师、采样轮次组织的 JSONL 文件，并把数据集标为 CC-BY-NC-4.0。其数据卡同时提醒：每个唯一问题会重复 12 次，部分 ground_truth 可能不准确，而且受限于条件只能开源完整数据的一个子集。因此，论文中“已发布全部数据与方法”的宽泛表述不能作为完整性保证。链接的 GitHub 项目树只有论文 PDF 与资源文件，没有端到端 DeepDistill 实现。

title: Novelty
新意
html: DeepDistill's useful distinction is the joint data object: sourced prompts, capability-spanning teachers, repeated attempts, heterogeneous verification, and teacher-specific success rates at unusually large claimed scale. Instead of asking one model for a subjective difficulty score, it estimates difficulty from observed response outcomes and uses variation across repeated DeepSeek-R1 attempts to locate unstable examples. The two-stage selection recipe then moves from a broad, correctness-filtered mixture to a smaller high-variation annealing set. This is a construction-and-selection contribution; it is not a domain-neutral verifier and does not establish that CV is intrinsic difficulty.

DeepDistill 的主要区别在于把多种信息合成同一个数据对象：有来源的提示、能力跨度不同的教师、多次尝试、异构验证，以及各教师的成功率，并把规模扩展到论文宣称的约 4000 万条响应。它没有让单一模型主观打难度分，而是依据实际响应结果估计难度，再用 DeepSeek-R1 多次尝试的波动识别不稳定样本。两阶段配方先得到经过正确性筛选的宽覆盖混合数据，再收缩为高波动退火集。其贡献是数据构造与选择方法，而不是领域无关的可靠验证器，也未证明 CV 等同于任务固有难度。 关于《DeepDistill: Enhancing LLM Reasoning Capabilities via Large-Scale Difficulty-Graded Data Training》：创新性应按可操作的数据变换判断：新增了什么对象、筛选器或反馈合同，以及它与常见蒸馏、拒绝采样或结果验证有何区别。仅扩大样本量或报告更高分数不足以单独证明数据方法创新。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
Release completeness is unresolved. The paper claims approximately 40 million responses and says all data and methods are public, while the official dataset card explicitly calls the release a subset. The exact released-versus-complete record mapping, rejected examples, generation prompts, decoding parameters, and category-specific CV thresholds are unknown. The dataset-level CC-BY-NC-4.0 label does not by itself establish compatibility with every upstream corpus. The paper says PPL comes from a prior 32B model, whereas the dataset card says a 7B model.

Verifier reliability is uneven. A learned fallback can overturn Math-Verify failures; science and open-ended records rely on learned judges; instruction constraints are partly model-generated; and code uses no more than ten available public tests. The dataset card itself warns of inaccurate ground truths. Decontamination is documented for AIME2024 only, not GPQA-Diamond or LiveCodeBench. Repeated responses are also correlated through common prompts, teachers, and validators, so pass rate and CV are pipeline-dependent measurements. Finally, the experiments lack an ablation that isolates corpus scale, verification, CV selection, and the unusually high learning rate, and Stage II reduces LiveCodeBench performance.

公开完整性仍未解决。论文宣称约 4000 万条响应并称全部数据与方法已公开，但官方数据卡明确把公开内容称为完整数据的子集。公开记录与完整记录的精确映射、被拒样本、生成提示、解码参数和各类别 CV 阈值均未知。数据集层面的 CC-BY-NC-4.0 标签也不能单独证明与每个上游语料的许可兼容。论文称 PPL 来自此前训练的 32B 模型，数据卡却称来自 7B 模型。

不同类别的验证可靠性并不一致。学习式复核器可以推翻 Math-Verify 的失败；科学与开放式记录依赖学习式评估器；指令约束部分由模型生成；代码最多只用十个可用公开测试。数据卡还主动警告标准答案可能不准确。去污染只明确覆盖 AIME2024，没有覆盖 GPQA-Diamond 或 LiveCodeBench。多次响应也共享提示、教师与验证器，因此通过率和 CV 都依赖具体流水线。最后，实验没有分别隔离语料规模、验证、CV 筛选与高学习率的贡献，而且第二阶段使 LiveCodeBench 下降。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
Within the data-construction/open-release track, this card is most useful as a worked example of a large trace-plus-feedback release. Builders can study difficulty-aware SFT, compare teacher capability curves, construct curricula from pass rates, or audit where programmatic and learned verification disagree. The explicit source, teacher, category, score, and pass-rate fields make it possible to preserve lineage while resampling the corpus.

Reuse should start from a pinned Hugging Face revision and the files actually accessible there, not the 40M headline alone. Users should group by unique question before splitting, audit ground_truth and public tests, interpret each category's score separately, and retain upstream source identifiers for license review. DPO and GRPO are mentioned as possible downstream applications, but the paper demonstrates SFT only; they should remain hypotheses rather than recorded training evidence.

在“数据构造与开放发布”轨道中，这张卡最适合作为大规模“轨迹+反馈”发布案例。构建者可以研究难度感知 SFT、比较不同教师的能力曲线、按通过率构造课程，或审计程序化验证与学习式验证在哪些样本上分歧。明确的问题来源、教师、类别、分数和通过率字段，使重采样时仍能保留谱系。

复用应从固定版本的 Hugging Face 仓库和实际可访问文件出发，而不是只依据“4000 万”标题。切分前应按唯一问题分组，审计 ground_truth 与公开测试，分别解释各类别分数，并保留上游来源标识以复核许可。论文只把 DPO 与 GRPO 列为潜在下游用途，实际展示的是 SFT；因此前两者应保留为待验证假设，而不能写成已有训练证据。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Read Sections 2.1-2.5 first for the source mixture, decontamination, teacher generation, verifier contracts, and quality filters.
  • Separate three quantities: roughly 3.34M unique queries, about 40M intended teacher responses, and the officially caveated public subset.
  • In Section 3, note that CV is computed from repeated DeepSeek-R1 verification scores and that the category-specific CV thresholds are not published.
  • Read Tables 1-2 together: Stage II improves AIME2024 and GPQA-Diamond for 32B but lowers LiveCodeBench.
  • Treat the Hugging Face limitations and schema as part of the paper evidence; they expose label, duplication, and release-scope risks absent from the headline.

• 先读第 2.1-2.5 节，确认来源混合、去污染、教师生成、验证契约与质量过滤。
  • 区分三个数量：约 334 万条唯一查询、约 4000 万条目标教师响应，以及官方明确加注限制的公开子集。
  • 阅读第 3 节时注意：CV 来自多次 DeepSeek-R1 响应的验证分数，各类别 CV 阈值并未公布。
  • 联读表 1 与表 2：第二阶段让 32B 的 AIME2024 和 GPQA-Diamond 上升，却使 LiveCodeBench 下降。
  • 把 Hugging Face 的限制说明与字段模式也视为论文证据；其中暴露了标题没有呈现的标签、重复和发布范围风险。
